Batteries lose capacity as they age. The degrade rate is set by a sandbox option, so you can make them last longer.

<SIZE:medium> Storing power <LINE> <SIZE:small> Power is stored in deep-cycle batteries: a 200Ah cell, a 400Ah cell, a DIY build, or a wired car battery. Create a battery bank to house them - its total capacity grows with every battery you install.
A finished panel can be split back into its parts if you need to recover materials or relocate it.

<SIZE:medium> Building panels <LINE> <SIZE:small> Craft solar panel parts, then assemble them into a flat (roof), wall-mounted, or floor-mounted panel. An inverter converts the raw output into usable power. <LINE> <LINE> Panels only generate when placed outdoors with a clear view of the sky.
Open the battery bank's status window to monitor everything. Its Summary, Details, and Debug tabs show panel status, battery level, and troubleshooting tools.

<SIZE:medium> Wiring it together <LINE> <SIZE:small> Place a power bank to tie your panels and batteries into a generator your base can run on. Connect each solar panel to the battery bank, then activate the power bank to begin charging and supplying power.
Sandbox options let you tune solar efficiency, charge speed, battery degrade, and how often pre-built solar gear spawns in the world.

<SIZE:medium> Off-grid solar power <LINE> <SIZE:small> Jeeve's Solar Arrays lets you harvest sunlight to run your base without fuel. The basic loop: build solar panels, set up a battery bank with deep-cycle batteries, connect the panels, then draw the stored power. <LINE> <LINE> Start by reading 'New Advancements: Energy From The Sun' to learn every recipe you need.
The drain calculation method and charge frequency can both be changed in the sandbox options to match how your server plays.

<SIZE:medium> No power? <LINE> <SIZE:small> Work through the checklist: panels are outdoors with clear sky; enough panels are connected; it is daytime with real sunlight; the power bank has been activated; and every panel is connected to the battery bank. A solar failsafe can keep critical power flowing when charge runs low.
